I give up. I could not find a proof I could finish in this session.

The plan I considered was to write `w` as an autocorrelation `w(a,b) = Σ_p c(p)·c(p − (a,b))` for a small integer array `c`. Then `A(S) = Σ_z (Σ_{s∈S} c(z−s))²`, and an extreme-point argument shows the inner sum is nonzero somewhere when `S` is nonempty. The autocorrelation step does not work with a single integer array. In a 3×3 support box, the constraints from `w(2,2) = −1`, `w(2,0) = 2`, `w(0,2) = 2` and the row and column sums of `w` lead to contradictions in every sign case I checked. I did not find a sum-of-squares decomposition with two or more integer arrays, and I did not get as far as formalizing the reindexing. So the file is unchanged, and it still contains the `sorry`.
